props.gloss_en: (the mishnah, cited) an incident: Elders went down from Jerusalem to their cities [and decreed a fast]...
and they decreed a fast because there was seen in Ashkelon blight as much as fills the mouth of an oven
or perhaps an ovenful of bread?
(asked) like the cover of the oven?
or perhaps like a row of loaves that goes around the mouth of the oven?
